Below is a record of R exercises I've worked through, in the order completed. Each entry is its own page, with the data cleaned systematically — checking before and after each fix, using both base R and tidyverse approaches.

## [Entry 1: df2 Data Cleaning — Case, Spacing, and Missing Data](learning-entry1.qmd)

Cleaned a student data set across three columns (name, final_score, passed), each with case, spacing, or missing-value issues.

## [Entry 2: Survey Data Cleaning — RespondentID, Age_Group, Satisfaction, and Would_Recommend](learning-entry2.qmd)

Cleaned a survey data set across four columns, including missing values, duplication, and a mid-exercise pivot from relabeling each step separately to building a connected chain of fixes.

## [Entry 3: Customer Data Cleaning — Customer_name, Order_id, Order_date, and Email](learning-entry3.qmd) 

Cleaned a customer data set across four columns, including case,spacing,and missing value issues.
